heard: NASA's first communication satellite was a giant silver balloon. It stretched a massive 100 feet across in space. Engineers built it from thin plastic film coated with aluminum. Workers packed the massive sphere into a tiny canister. Once in orbit, it inflated into a gleaming sky mirror. This mirror bounced the first satellite phone calls across Earth. But its tracking antenna also accidentally heard the big bang. And to think, it all started as a giant silver balloon.
